strands.name: Strand A: Scientific Investigation Skills and Career Exploration

overalls.title: Scientific Investigation Skills
overalls.description: demonstrate scientific investigation skills (related to both inquiry and research) in the four areas of skills (initiating and planning, performing and recording, analysing and interpreting, and communicating)

specifics.description: I can ask scientific questions, make predictions, and plan safe investigations.
I can conduct experiments, collect accurate data, and organize it effectively.
I can analyse and interpret data, identify sources of error, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
I can communicate my findings using scientific language, appropriate formats, and precise measurements.

overalls.title: Career Exploration
overalls.description: identify and describe a variety of careers related to the fields of science under study, and identify scientists, including Canadians, who have made contributions to those fields

specifics.description: I can identify science-related careers and describe the education and training required.
I can describe the contributions of Canadian scientists to the fields under study.

strands.name: Strand B: Biology: Tissues, Organs, and Systems of Living Things

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate the importance of medical and other technological developments related to systems biology, and analyse their societal and ethical implications

specifics.description: I can evaluate the impact of medical technologies and public health strategies on society and the environment.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate cell division, cell specialization, organs, and systems in animals and plants, using research and inquiry skills, including various laboratory techniques

specifics.description: I can use scientific terminology correctly when investigating cells, tissues, organs, and systems.
I can examine cells under a microscope to identify mitosis and compare specialized cell structures.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the hierarchical organization of cells, from tissues, to organs, to systems in animals and plants

specifics.description: I can explain the cell cycle, mitosis, and how cell division and specialization support growth and repair.
I can describe how cells, tissues, organs, and systems work together to keep organisms alive.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse a variety of safety and environmental issues associated with chemical reactions, including the ways in which chemical reactions can be applied to address environmental challenges

specifics.description: I can analyse safety and environmental issues related to chemical reactions and their applications.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate, through inquiry, the characteristics of chemical reactions

specifics.description: I can investigate and classify different types of chemical reactions, including synthesis, decomposition, and displacement.
I can use molecular models, word equations, and balanced equations to represent chemical reactions.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the general principles of chemical reactions, and various ways to represent them

specifics.description: I can describe evidence of chemical change and write balanced chemical equations using the law of conservation of mass.
I can describe acids, bases, the pH scale, and neutralization reactions.

strands.name: Strand D: Earth and Space Science: Climate Change

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse some of the effects of climate change around the world, and assess the effectiveness of initiatives that attempt to address the issue of climate change

specifics.description: I can analyse the effects of climate change and evaluate the effectiveness of initiatives that address it.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate various natural and human factors that influence Earth's climate and climate change

specifics.description: I can investigate natural and human factors that influence climate change using models, data, and simulations.
I can analyse scientific data and compare different perspectives on climate change.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of natural and human factors, including the greenhouse effect, that influence Earth's climate and contribute to climate change

specifics.description: I can explain the natural and anthropogenic greenhouse effect and the factors that contribute to climate change.
I can describe the sources and sinks of greenhouse gases and indicators of global climate change.

strands.name: Strand E: Physics: Light and Geometric Optics

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate the effectiveness of technological devices and procedures designed to make use of light, and assess their social benefits

specifics.description: I can evaluate how technologies that use light benefit society and improve human perception.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate, through inquiry, the properties of light, and predict its behaviour, particularly with respect to reflection in plane and curved mirrors and refraction in converging lenses

specifics.description: I can investigate the laws of reflection and refraction using ray diagrams and laboratory experiments.
I can predict and test the characteristics of images formed by mirrors and converging lenses.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of various characteristics and properties of light, particularly with respect to reflection in mirrors and reflection and refraction in lenses

specifics.description: I can explain the properties of light, including reflection, refraction, and the electromagnetic spectrum.
I can describe how mirrors and lenses are used in optical instruments and explain natural optical phenomena.
